summary: Nomura Holdings filed a 6-K furnishing its monthly Share Buyback Report (Japanese buyback disclosure mapped to a US issuer repurchase update) covering August 1-31, 2026. Under the January 30, 2026 board authorization for 100,000,000 shares or JPY 60,000,000,000, repurchases through August 31 totaled 46,861,200 shares for JPY 59,999,879,300, exhausting the yen cap (100.0% of amount, 46.9% of share cap). The authorization runs from February 17 to September 30, 2026, excluding ten business days after quarterly results. Treasury shares stand at 165,592,707 of 3,088,562,601 issued. Watch for further authorizations, cancellation of treasury stock, and buyback-driven EPS support into period end.
